construct: The ecological fallacy occurs when an association observed using aggregate group-level data is incorrectly assumed to hold at the individual level; group-level joint distributions do not establish individual-level exposure-outcome relationships.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The study measures only county-level exposure and outcome aggregates, then asserts an individual-level relationship. That cross-level inference is the ecological fallacy.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Simpson paradox concerns association reversal after aggregation/stratification, while recall, regression-dilution, and immortal-time biases require entirely different data-generating mechanisms.
